subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

NAB
solution:
The correct answer is 'free.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word 'Nab' means **to catch or arrest somebody who is doing something wrong**. (दोषी व्‍यक्ति को पकड़ना या हिरासत में लेना)

 
 
• Example: *The police failed to **nab** the thief*.
 
 
 
• ​Let's see the meaning of the given options:-
 
 
• 'Catch' means **to capture somebody or something that you have been following or looking for**. (पीछाकर या ढूँढ़कर पकड़ना)
 
 
• Example: *It takes a thief to **catch** a thief*.
 
 
 
• 'Grab' means** to take hold of something or someone suddenly and roughly. **(किसी चीज या किसी को अचानक और मोटे तौर पर पकड़ना)
 
 
• Example: *We would run and **grab** them*.
 
 
 
• 'Free' means **to let somebody or something leave or escape from a place where he or she or it is held**. (बंदीगृह से छोड़ना; क़ैद से आज़ाद करना; बंधनमुक्त करना)
 
 
• Example: *Laws catch flies but let hornets go **free***.
 
 
 
• 'Arrest' means to **seize someone by legal authority and take them into custody**. (गिरफ़्तार करना; बंदी बनाना)
 
 
• Example: *Vanzara and other policemen wanted to **arrest **Sohrabuddin*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The antonyms of the word 'Nab' are "free, release, discharge".
 
• The synonyms of the word 'Nab' are "catch, grab, arrest".
